title: 资管CIO Adam Gold：AI交易为何周末前波动加剧？
speaker: Adam Gold

segments.en: Good morning, and trust you're well. What's your prognosis? Why are markets so edgy going into this weekend?
segments.zh: 早上好，希望你一切顺利。你的预测是什么？为什么进入这个周末市场如此紧张？

segments.en: Well, we've had a lot of uncertainty, and investors don't like when questions can't be answered.
segments.zh: 嗯，我们有很多不确定性，当问题无法回答时，市场参与者不喜欢这样。

segments.en: So we had a lot of concern into the midterms.
segments.zh: 所以我们对中期选举有很多担忧。

segments.en: There was a blue tsunami, a little bit shocking to people.
segments.zh: 出现了蓝色浪潮，有点让人震惊。

segments.en: That raises questions about what's going to happen in more auditoriums for data centers.
segments.zh: 这引发了关于更多数据中心礼堂将会发生什么的疑问。

segments.en: And the AI trade would have had a lot of correlation.
segments.zh: 而人工智能交易会有很多相关性。

segments.en: That was all similar. There was a big drop in the July period, a big rebound.
segments.zh: 这些都类似。七月期间大幅下跌，然后大幅反弹。

segments.en: There have been just sort of waves and themes. Software is down one day, semis are up, and vice versa.
segments.zh: 只是一波波的主题。软件某天下跌，半导体上涨，反之亦然。

segments.en: So there's just a lot of a lot of groupthink. And unfortunately, this is unwinding because one of the greatest founders of all time has left the company that he ran.
segments.zh: 所以有很多群体思维。不幸的是，这正在瓦解，因为一位有史以来最伟大的创始人离开了他经营的公司。

segments.en: So I think this has caused an extra, an extra dynamite in this bear case for the moment.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这给目前的看跌理由增添了额外的动力。

segments.en: But I think there will be a resolution at some point. But at the moment, we don't have a lot of answers to these questions.
segments.zh: 但我认为最终会有解决方案。不过目前，我们对这些问题还没有太多答案。

segments.en: And even in a big debut, I can't drop it.
segments.zh: 即便在大型首秀中，我也无法忽视它。

segments.en: Wasn't enough to revive this whole AI trade, Adam.
segments.zh: 不足以重振整个AI交易，亚当。

segments.en: Can we call this IPO a success?
segments.zh: 我们能称这次IPO为成功吗？
